item.title: Showcase Impact, Not Just Years 🎓 • Quantify your achievements—use numbers. • Use: “I increased sales by 30% in 6 months.” • Focus on skills over tenure—highlight expertise. • Show continuous learning—certificates, courses. • Tailor your resume to the job description. How can you demonstrate value beyond years of experience in your field? #career #resume #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
